page_title: Eidolon -- AI Agent Server for the Enterprise

summary.name: Eidolon
summary.one_liner: Eidolon is an open source, enterprise-oriented AI Agent Server and Python-based agent SDK for building, deploying, and consuming GenAI agent applications.
use_cases: Building chatbot agents with RAG storage
Deploying AI agents to Kubernetes clusters
Building React GUIs for chatbot agents
Calling agents through a REST API
summary.what_it_does: Eidolon offers two parts: an Agent Server, described as a secure, enterprise-ready deployment server for agentic applications, and the Eidolon SDK, a pluggable framework for building agents. Agents can be defined with declarative YAML or with vanilla code or other agent frameworks. Agents are deployed directly to Kubernetes and are described as stateless, so they scale horizontally. Kubernetes policies can restrict agents to needed resources. Consumption options include a set of React components for building chatbot GUIs, a REST API for running actions, an Eidolon webui, and a CLI.
notable: Declarative YAML agent definitions, from one line up to complex setups
Deploys to Kubernetes with enforceable policies limiting agent resource access
Provides React components and a REST API for consuming agents
Agents are stateless and scale horizontally
caveats: Deployment assumes Kubernetes tooling and pipelines; no non-Kubernetes deployment is described on the page
Page gives no pricing,版本 or license details beyond being open source
